title: ContentBundle
description: Schema for the Axiom game content bundle (content.json). Contains all static game data: modes, stages, levels, challenge levels, and cosmetics.

contentVersion.description: Incremented on every breaking schema change (renamed/removed IDs, added required fields, removed question types).

schemaVersion.description: Incremented on every breaking change to the save-data schema. Used to trigger migration functions on load.

modes.description: All subject-area modes, ordered from most foundational to most advanced.

stages.description: All curriculum stages across all modes.

cosmetics.description: All unlockable cosmetic items (avatars, badges, themes, frames).

Mode.title: Mode
Mode.description: A top-level subject area. The first selection a student makes after profile setup.

title.description: Human-readable mode name shown on the Mode Select screen.

description.description: Brief summary shown on the Mode Select screen.

order.description: Linear position across all modes (1 = most foundational). Must be unique across modes.

stageIds.description: Ordered list of stage IDs belonging to this mode.

Stage.title: Stage
Stage.description: A curriculum unit within a Mode. Contains regular levels and a challenge level.

modeId.description: ID of the Mode this stage belongs to.

description.description: Brief description of the stage topic.

order.description: Sort order within the parent mode (not global). Must be unique within the mode.

prerequisiteStageIds.description: IDs of stages within the same mode that must be completed (challenge passed) before this stage unlocks.

levels.description: Ordered list of regular playable levels in this stage.

challengeLevel.description: The final gate for this stage. Must be passed to unlock the next stage.

passingStarThreshold.description: Minimum total stars across all regular levels required to unlock the challenge level.

Level.title: Level
Level.description: A single playable unit within a stage. Configures the problem generator and scoring thresholds.

stageId.description: ID of the stage this level belongs to.

order.description: Position within the stage. Levels are presented in ascending order.

introduction.description: Optional introductory content shown before the first question. null = no intro screen.

hintAllowance.description: Maximum number of hints available per session. 0 = hints disabled.

questionCount.description: Number of questions generated per play session.

timeLimit.description: Time limit in seconds for the session. null = untimed.

generatorConfig.description: Configuration for the problem generation engine for this level.

starThresholds.description: Accuracy thresholds (as percentages 0-100) required to earn 1, 2, or 3 stars.

LevelIntroduction.title: LevelIntroduction
LevelIntroduction.description: Optional introductory content shown to the student before the first question of a level.

body.description: Brief plain-text explanation of what this level covers.

examplePrompt.description: An optional worked example problem shown alongside the body. Should differ from generated questions.

exampleSolution.description: Step-by-step solution for the worked example in examplePrompt.

StarThresholds.title: StarThresholds
StarThresholds.description: Accuracy percentage thresholds (0-100) required to earn each star rating.

oneStar.description: Minimum accuracy percentage to earn 1 star.

twoStar.description: Minimum accuracy percentage to earn 2 stars.

threeStar.description: Minimum accuracy percentage to earn 3 stars (speed bonus may apply).

ChallengeLevel.title: ChallengeLevel
ChallengeLevel.description: A pass/fail assessment at the end of every stage. Must be passed to unlock the next stage. Does not award stars or XP.

stageId.description: ID of the stage this challenge level belongs to.

title.description: Human-readable title for the challenge (e.g. 'Stage Challenge').

questionCount.description: Number of questions in the challenge session. Typically 15-20.

timeLimit.description: Time limit in seconds for the challenge session. null = untimed.

passingAccuracy.description: Accuracy fraction (0-1) the player must meet or exceed to pass the challenge.

retryAllowed.description: Whether the player may reattempt the challenge after failing.

generatorConfigs.description: One GeneratorConfig per question type covered in the stage. The challenge samples across all of them to ensure full topic coverage.

difficultyWeights.description: Weighted distribution of question difficulty for the challenge. easy + medium + hard should sum to 1.0.

DifficultyWeights.title: DifficultyWeights
DifficultyWeights.description: Proportions of questions at each difficulty tier. easy + medium + hard should sum to 1.0. Default: { easy: 0.2, medium: 0.3, hard: 0.5 }.

GeneratorConfig.title: GeneratorConfig
GeneratorConfig.description: Tells the problem generation engine what kinds of questions to produce for a level or challenge.

questionTypes.description: Which interaction types are eligible for question generation. Must contain at least one entry.

allowNegatives.description: Whether the generator may produce negative operands or answers.

allowFractions.description: Whether the generator may produce fractional operands or answers.

allowDecimals.description: Whether the generator may produce decimal operands or answers.

variableCount.description: Number of algebraic variables to introduce. null = no variables (pure arithmetic).

difficultyRange.description: Inclusive [min, max] difficulty bounds on the 1-10 scale. The generator picks uniformly within this range.

OperandConfig.title: OperandConfig
OperandConfig.description: Numeric bounds applied to operand generation. The generator constrains all operands to [min, max].

QuestionType.title: QuestionType
QuestionType.description: The interaction type of a generated question.

Cosmetic.title: Cosmetic
Cosmetic.description: An unlockable reward item (avatar, badge, theme, or frame).

name.description: Human-readable name shown in the cosmetics gallery.

description.description: Short description of the cosmetic item.

unlockCondition.description: Condition that must be satisfied for this cosmetic to be awarded to the player.

assetRef.description: Path or key for the visual asset (image, theme token, etc.).

UnlockCondition.title: UnlockCondition
UnlockCondition.description: Describes what the player must achieve to unlock a cosmetic.

type.description: The kind of achievement that triggers the unlock.

value.description: The threshold or identifier for the condition. e.g. 500 for an XP threshold, or a stageId string for stage-complete.
